# OpenSpawn

> OpenSpawn is an open-source coordination layer for AI agent organizations. You define your entire agent org — roles, hierarchy, culture, policies — in a single markdown file (ORG.md), and OpenSpawn parses it, spawns agents, routes tasks through the hierarchy, and gives you a real-time dashboard. It is infrastructure, not a framework: it works with any agent stack (OpenClaw, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, raw API calls).

## Documentation

- [Getting Started](https://openspawn.ai/docs/getting-started.md): Install, create your first org, run the sandbox
- [How It Works](https://openspawn.ai/docs/how-it-works.md): Architecture, agent levels, simulation modes
- [ORG.md Reference](https://openspawn.ai/docs/reference/org-md-reference.md): Full spec for the org definition file
- [MCP Integration](https://openspawn.ai/docs/protocols/mcp.md): Model Context Protocol tools and endpoints
- [MCP Reference](https://openspawn.ai/docs/protocols/mcp-reference.md): Complete MCP tool listing
- [A2A Protocol](https://openspawn.ai/docs/protocols/a2a.md): Agent-to-Agent communication spec
- [ACP vs A2A](https://openspawn.ai/docs/concepts/acp-vs-a2a.md): When to use which protocol
- [Communication Protocol](https://openspawn.ai/docs/communication-protocol.md): Push/pull message routing
- [Comparison](https://openspawn.ai/docs/comparison.md): How OpenSpawn differs from CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen
- [Templates](https://openspawn.ai/docs/templates.md): Industry-specific org templates
- [Agent Quickstart](https://openspawn.ai/docs/agent-quickstart.md): Deploy agents to OpenClaw
- [OpenClaw Quickstart](https://openspawn.ai/docs/openclaw-quickstart.md): Gateway integration guide
- [Connecting Agents](https://openspawn.ai/docs/guides/connecting-agents.md): Wire agents to the coordinator
- [Dashboard Guide](https://openspawn.ai/docs/guides/dashboard-guide.md): Using the real-time dashboard
- [Your First ORG.md](https://openspawn.ai/docs/tutorials/your-first-org-md.md): Tutorial

## Quick Start

```bash
npx openspawn init my-org
cd my-org && npx openspawn preview
```
